content: Me malabumuŋnit’walaŋ kutibulabulaye eŋ Bepaŋ niutumba diniŋ kap
Bepaŋne, Bepaŋne, du maŋgoŋde binabulaŋ? Be maŋgandok tiŋa mu nehitubu-lodalaŋ? Be maŋgoŋdok tiŋa kutibulabulayene mu nadilaŋ?
Bepaŋ, nu hadapmo kutiganilat, iŋgoŋ du mu nadinamulaŋ. Tiŋa undugoŋ timiŋ adi hakulenit mokit hakutiganilat.
Iŋgoŋ du adi titiŋ momooŋ eŋ didimeniŋ diniŋ Bepaŋ. Du mapme uŋgoniŋ ilune Isilaehidi ganintiloiŋ.
Koom mamani-papaniye adi du nadisukilitigamgiŋ. Adi nadisukilitigamgiŋ doktiŋa yehitubu-lodaune memik heki yehitifogiŋ.
Adi nadisukilitigamuŋa welemulap mu tigiŋ. Eŋ du ganinadigiŋ kaŋ memik heki’walaŋ kohohik gineniŋ yanagikuŋ.
Iŋgoŋ nu adi meeniŋ dabugoŋ mooŋ, nu adi miŋgembem nabugoŋ. Metamdi nabuhaŋindaaŋ nanintifooŋ sigilulum tinamiiŋ.
Metam hogohogok nu nabuŋa adi nanimpekit tiiŋ, eŋ mabelap tiŋa mebiguguŋ tinamiiŋ.
Adi indiŋ yoiŋ, “Du Yahwe nadisukilitimilaŋ. Iŋgoŋ dediŋdok tiŋa adi kotigoŋ mu gehitubu-lodaaŋ ganagitak?”
Bepaŋ, dagoŋ maŋ’walaŋ weleŋ gineniŋ momooŋ hinek nabudokoune mintagut. Tiŋa eyaŋ-kabe gineŋ maaŋ nabudokoguŋ.
Nu tububihila maŋdi nanagikuk, nai uŋaniŋ du foloŋ ulodiŋa hatigut. Du adi maŋdi nanagikuk nai uŋaniŋ tububihila Bepaŋne hatiguŋdi hatilaŋ.
I agaŋ malabumuŋ tububihila mintanamulak doktiŋa du mu binabeŋ. Nu nehitubu-lodadok nebek noli nemoŋ.
Memikneye adi makau maahi nabugoŋ nehikelemadiiŋ. Adi yadi makau maahi fafaŋehi mikhinit Basan kwetneŋhi nabugoŋ.
Adi yadi laiondi maŋiŋ dilitomuŋa kale nanaŋdok mahaŋ tolak, wondok tuwot nehitubu-kadaka tinene woomhat tiiŋ.

Saŋiniŋne adi ime kwetfoloŋ kweheune fooŋ liwelak, wondok tuwot dambek udapmalak. Kaŋ kitiline tomboyout tiŋa haliwiiŋ hogohogok u diliteledapmaŋ tiiŋ. Kaŋ welene maaneŋ nemenemek dambek liwedapmaune saŋiniŋ eŋ nadinadi lohilat.
Tiŋa mane silidaune mebelemne looŋ mane hapmeneŋ galiŋa hatak. Kaŋ du binabune kumumbe tilat.
Me kadakahi adi kamo hekidi kale moiŋ yehikelemadiiŋ nabugoŋ nehikelemadiiŋ. Tiŋa kayone kohone youtom tiiŋ.
Kitiline hogohogok miŋgilaŋgoŋ mintadapmalak. Kaŋ meheki woŋ adi malabumuŋ u minta-nambune nabuŋa nadifo tiiŋ.
Adi tinahukutne daneeŋ moŋgokiiŋ, tiŋa undugoŋ nediyeŋ fafaŋeeŋ dahidahine wahiniŋ tibek yoŋa kat kukiiŋ.
Yahwe, du binabuŋa wooŋ kweetniŋ mu haleŋ. Tubulodane Momooŋ, kamiŋ maaŋ pilap buŋa nehitubu-lodaweŋ.
Du kotigoŋ nanagilune adi tuwot mu nulukumuneŋ. Du nehitubu-lodaune kamo nabugoŋ heki wendi mu nulukumuneŋ, kaŋ kaipmuŋ hatiluwaat.

Laiondi kale moihi yehisiŋa nalak wondok tuwolit nehinane tiiŋ. Tiŋa undugoŋ adi yadi makau moihi nabugoŋ unduŋ haliŋa keleuhikdi nedene tiiŋ. Unduŋ doktiŋa du adi kohohik gineniŋ kotigoŋ nehikibidaleŋ.
Du unduŋ tibeŋ kaŋ nu metamneye du kwanai saŋiniŋnit tuguŋ u yenihautait. Adi ganiutumbadok bopneune nu adi’walaŋ lekiŋgoŋhik gineŋ wooŋ wohoge yotiloluwaat.
Nu indiŋ yobit. “Bepaŋ’walaŋ metamŋiye, hidi wou nintiloneŋ. Jekop’walaŋ me yalakiŋiye, hidi Yahwe wou nintiloneŋ. Biyagoŋ, Isilaehi, hidi gikiŋgoŋ timiŋa niutumbaneŋ.
Adi me fiyewakahi sigilulum mu tiyemilak. Be malabumuŋ tiŋa folofigitahikdok nadiune nemek haŋindaaŋ mu tilak. Adi biyabuŋa kweetniŋ mu hatilak, wendoktiŋa ninadiiŋ kaŋ yonadihik u nadiyemulak.”
Youtumbadok bop wapum mintaluwaakneŋ du maŋgoŋ tuguŋ wendok yohautaaŋ wohoge ganintiloluwaat. Tiŋa siloŋ koom titiŋdok yofafaŋegut u metam gikiŋgoŋ tiiŋ heki namandahik foloŋ tibit.
Metam fiyewakahi adi yadi nanaŋe natoki tineŋ. Kaŋ Yahwe’walaŋ metamŋiye adi wou nintiloneŋ. Kaŋ Bepaŋdi kahaŋ tiyembune nadifo foloŋ hatiŋa wooŋ hatiyaneeŋ.
Kwetfoloŋ metam hogohogok Bepaŋ doktiŋa adi’walaŋkade buneeŋ. Yahwedi mapme ilaŋa metam hogohogok yabudokolak, unduŋ doktiŋa adi hogok niutumbaneeŋ.
Kwetkwet me fokohinit adi hinamuni tiŋa mulelem timiŋa niutumbaneeŋ. Kwetfoloŋ metam hogohogok kumuŋ tigiŋ be kaipmuŋ hatiŋa kougoŋ kumuneeŋ, adi wanakaŋ mulelem tiŋa Bepaŋ niutumbaneeŋ.
Metam kougoŋ mintaneeŋ heki adi Bepaŋ’walaŋ kwanai tineeŋ. Adi metam kougoŋ mintaneeŋ Bepaŋ’walaŋ kahat tiyembune nadineeŋ.
Metam u mu mintagiŋ, ala kougoŋ mintaune indiŋ yenineeŋ, “Bepaŋdi metamŋiye kotigoŋ yanagikuk.”
